system_prompt: Complete the user's Stella modeling task through the available MCP tools. Use the exact model IDs and output paths requested. Treat tool errors as recoverable evidence: inspect the error, correct the request, and continue. Do not claim an operation succeeded unless its tool result confirms success. Finish with a concise account of the model and analysis completed.

scenarios.description: Plan and complete a build, validation, simulation, rendering, and strict save workflow from a user-level specification.
scenarios.prompt: Create a Stella model named Agent Evaluation Growth with model ID agent_growth. Simulate from year 0 through year 5 with a time step of 1 using Euler integration. The Population stock starts at 100 people. The growth inflow is Population * growth_rate in people/Year, and growth_rate is 0.1 1/Year. Validate the model, run it, render its diagram, and save it in strict mode to ${ARTIFACT_DIR}/agent_growth.stmx.

scenarios.description: Plan and complete a template load, parameter edit, validation, simulation, rendering, and strict save workflow.
scenarios.prompt: Load the built-in SIR template as model ID agent_sir. Change beta to 0.2 while leaving gamma and the initial stocks unchanged. Validate and simulate the edited model, render the diagram, and save it in strict mode to ${ARTIFACT_DIR}/agent_sir.stmx.

scenarios.description: Plan and complete an imported-model inspection, baseline run, scenario comparison, sensitivity analysis, and strict save workflow.
scenarios.prompt: Read ${REPO_ROOT}/tests/fixtures/compat_corpus/stella_4_1_1_accumulator.stmx as model ID agent_analysis and inspect it. Run the baseline simulation. Compare it with a scenario named double rate that sets rate to 2 and save the comparison CSV to ${ARTIFACT_DIR}/agent_accumulator_scenarios.csv. Then run a one-at-a-time sensitivity analysis for rate from 1 through 3 at 3 evenly spaced values, using the final Accumulator value as the output, and save the sweep to ${ARTIFACT_DIR}/agent_accumulator_sensitivity.csv. Save the model in strict mode to ${ARTIFACT_DIR}/agent_accumulator.stmx and summarize the numerical findings.
